ABOUT US

Your Beauty, Your Happy Place.

Beauty & Joy is a beauty parlour, hair salon, bridal makeup studio and beauty academy in Ramkatora, Varanasi. We focus on personalised care: listening to what you want, then creating a look that feels like you.

From everyday hair and skin care to wedding-day makeup and hairstyling, our team welcomes every guest warmly. [Editable: add the salon's story, founding year and team details once confirmed by the owner.]
